test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In June 2025, which of the following states increased the quota for minorities under its housing schemes from 10% to 15%?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Government of Karnataka** officially announced an increase in the reservation quota for **minority communities** within its state-sponsored housing schemes in **June 2025**.
 
• The quota has been enhanced from the previous **10%** to a revised **15%** to ensure better inclusivity and social security for marginalized sections of the population.
 
• This policy change applies to various housing projects executed by the **Housing Department** and the **Rajiv Gandhi Housing Corporation Limited (RGHCL)**.
 
• The primary beneficiaries of this 15% reservation include individuals belonging to the **Muslim, Christian, Jain, Sikh, Buddhist, and Parsi** communities residing in the state.
 
• The move is part of the **Karnataka** government's broader initiative to address the housing deficit among minorities and promote urban and rural development for all economic strata. ***Hence, the correct answer is Karnataka.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rajiv Gandhi Housing Corporation Limited (RGHCL):**
 
 
• Established in the **year 1991**, this special purpose vehicle is responsible for implementing central and state housing schemes in **Karnataka**.
 
• It focuses on providing **affordable housing** to the **Economically Weaker Sections (EWS)** and **Low Income Groups (LIG)** across the state.
 
 
 
• **Major Housing Schemes in Karnataka:**
 
 
• **Basava Vasati Yojana:** Launched to provide homes to the rural homeless, focusing on families living below the **poverty line**.
 
• **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Niwas Yojana:** A scheme specifically designed to provide housing assistance to the **Scheduled Castes (SC)** and **Scheduled Tribes (ST)** in both urban and rural areas.
 
• **Vajpayee Urban Housing Scheme:** Targets the urban poor to ensure they have access to **pucca houses** with basic amenities.
 
 
 
• **Minority Welfare in Karnataka:**
 
 
• The **Directorate of Minorities** in **Karnataka** was carved out of the **Social Welfare Department** in **1999-2000** to focus exclusively on the development of notified minority communities.
 
• Apart from housing, the state provides **scholarships**, **skill development training**, and **interest-free loans** through the **Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation (KMDC)**.
 
 
 
• **National Context:**
 
 
• Under the **National Commission for Minorities Act, 1992**, six religious communities are notified as minorities at the national level.
 
• State governments in **India** have the autonomy to implement specific welfare measures and **quotas** to uplift these communities based on their local demographic and socio-economic requirements.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Housing Department** of **Karnataka** aims to complete over **5 lakh houses** under various schemes by the end of the **financial year 2025-26**.
 
• To be eligible for these schemes, applicants must generally have an **annual income** below a specified threshold and must not already own a **permanent house** in the state.
 
• The **15% quota** for minorities is a significant step toward achieving the goals of **Housing for All**, aligning with the principles of the **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)** at the central level.
 
• The **Directorate of Minorities** and local **Panchayati Raj** institutions play a vital role in identifying genuine beneficiaries to prevent discrepancies in the allotment process.
